note: Drafted, not run. No with-skill or baseline run exists for these tasks. [script] assertions use scripts/flutter_scan.py or a plain string check; [judge] assertions need a blind grader. The script is the skill's own tool, so each task has judge assertions that measure something it does not control.

evals.prompt: This settings screen rebuilds too much and the console is noisy; one reviewer also said it can throw during build. The app is Flutter. Fix it and tell me what you changed. Save the fixed file as settings_screen.fixed.dart.
assertions: [script] flutter_scan.py on settings_screen.fixed.dart reports summary.warn equal to 0
[script] settings_screen.fixed.dart does not contain 'print('
[script] flutter_scan.py on settings_screen.fixed.dart reports no missing-const finding at confidence high
[judge] The answer explains that setState directly in build can trigger another build during the build, and moves the initial value to initState or a field initialiser
[judge] The answer states which Flutter and Dart versions it read or assumed and does not present unconfirmed version claims as fact
[judge] The SwitchListTile callback still calls setState inside the callback (that use is correct) and the answer does not remove it
[judge] The reply ends with the fixed report (Versions, Changed, Scan, Verified on device, Unconfirmed claims, Not checked) and says performance was not measured in profile mode on a device

evals.prompt: Users report that checkout sometimes submits with an empty cart and that the done screen sometimes opens after they left the page. Fix checkout_controller.dart and explain the root causes. Save as checkout_controller.fixed.dart.
assertions: [script] flutter_scan.py on checkout_controller.fixed.dart reports no unawaited-future finding
[script] checkout_controller.fixed.dart contains 'await loadCart()'
[script] checkout_controller.fixed.dart does not contain "_cart!['total']"
[judge] The answer names the dropped loadCart Future as the cause of the empty cart and fire-and-forget analytics as a deliberate choice wrapped in unawaited with its own error handling, or awaited

[judge] The fix guards the navigation after the await against a disposed context (a mounted check) or moves navigation out of the controller, and explains why a BuildContext stored in a controller is a risk
[judge] The answer handles a null or failed cart response with a clear failure path instead of a null assertion
[judge] Version-dependent claims (such as the minimum Flutter version for context.mounted) are marked verify (unconfirmed)

assertions: [script] The reply mentions line 10 and 'print'
